micro_faq.title: The questions we get asked most about plans

items.question: What happens if I use more voice minutes than included?
items.answer: You can keep using the service. Additional usage is billed per minute at the agreed rate. Contact us before activating voice to know the current conditions — we prefer to discuss it upfront rather than surprise you with a bill.

items.question: Can I change plan?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades apply from the next billing cycle. No penalties or additional costs.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. All plans are month-to-month. You can cancel whenever you want with no extra cost. The initial setup is a one-off payment, not an ongoing monthly fee.

items.question: Is the setup fee mandatory?
items.answer: Yes — and for good reason: it's the configuration work that ensures everything works from day one. Agent training, integrations, workflows and testing. It's a one-off payment, not a rental.
